sv.summary: Fem år efter att de grundade Anthropic ringde syskonen Dario och Daniela Amodei på torsdagen in det som väntas bli historiens största börsnotering. Enligt en källa till Wall Street Journal kan aktien öppna kring 104 dollar, mer än 20 procent över teckningskursen.

en.title: Siblings ring in – Anthropic expected to jump 20 percent
en.summary: Five years after founding Anthropic, siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei rang in on Thursday what is expected to become the largest stock market listing in history. en.title: Major discount in Koenigsegg deal – according to grey market

sv.title: Kompetensbristen hotar industrins återhämtning

en.title: Skills Shortage Threatens Industry's Recovery
en.summary: Sweden cannot train its way out of the skills shortage in classrooms alone. A large part of professional expertise must be built within companies.
